title: The Right To Use, Not The Work — and a Back Office Made Only of Cards
description: ADR 0012 จำกัดขอบเขตผู้ดูแลไว้ที่เนื้อหาและตัวเลขสรุป ซึ่งแคบเกินกว่างานจริง เพราะการต่ออายุหรือระงับสิทธิ์ต้องเขียนแถวที่ผูกกับลูกค้า ADR 0013 ขยายขอบเขตด้วยเส้นแบ่งที่ตรงกว่า: สิทธิ์การใช้งานทำได้ ตัวงานของลูกค้าทำไม่ได้ พร้อมกันนั้นหลังบ้านถูกทำให้ประกอบจากการ์ดชุดเดียวทั้งหมด เพื่อให้การเพิ่มหัวข้อใหม่เป็นการวางการ์ด ไม่ใช่การเขียน markup ใหม่
scope: ADR 0013 extends the administrator scope from platform content to the right to use, and forbids the work itself
list the tables an administrator may never read or write, by name
require an audit event with a stated reason on every entitlement change
hold the line that counting is not reading: the overview counts projects and never names one
build AdminCard, AdminGrid, AdminStat, AdminStatRow, AdminEmpty and AdminTable as the only markup an admin page may use
rebuild the overview page on those primitives and delete the bespoke panel and tile styles
verification: browser check on localhost:3000/admin while signed out: refusal renders, .admin-shell absent, zero .admin-card in the DOM, no platform figure in the page text
every admin class used in TSX has a matching rule in globals.css, checked by script rather than by eye
pnpm test 189 passed, 33 skipped; pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
rollback: กลับไป tag v0.30.0-platform-administration แล้ว revert commit ของ v0.31.0 ไม่มี migration ในรอบนี้ ADR 0013 ขยายขอบเขตบนกระดาษ แต่ยังไม่มีหน้าจอใดที่เขียนสิทธิ์ได้จริง
constraints: An admin page writes no markup of its own. Every section is a card primitive, so a change to the card moves every section at once.
Counting is not reading. The overview may count projects and may never render a project name.
The tables listed in ADR 0013 are closed to administrators for both read and write. Repository functions keep taking organizationId; the administrator grant adds no new way in.
Every entitlement change writes an audit event carrying the customer organization, the acting administrator and a stated reason. A reason field that accepts empty will be filled empty.

items.title: Extend the administrator scope to the right to use, and fix the back office to a single card system
Build the entitlement editor: find a customer by email or organization, change state and expiry, and require a reason
Prove by test that an administrator cannot reach a customer's project rows, not merely that the UI hides them
Build the pricing and promotion editors behind the administrator check, writing an audit event per change
Open payment collection: choose a provider, tie a settled invoice to an entitlement state, and write the ADR that governs it
Move the access tier copy out of source and into content the back-office owns
Decide whether trial entitlements issued under the five-day term are migrated to seven days
Show in the estimate where a Factor F came from: printed step or interpolation, and the two steps it sits between
Give the product a way to tell that the Factor F and labour circulars it holds are still the current ones
Bring the ว480 labour rate schedule in as a dataset, keeping the conditions that change a rate (quantity bands, area, method) as data rather than notes
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
Record ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ and ประมาณราคาโดย on the estimate so the sheet header can be filled
Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Give roadmap item ids a single owner: IP-059 was issued twice, in v0.18.0 and again in v0.20.0, for unrelated work
